answer: Admission auction: 100 slots are auctioned per epoch on a quartz-clear ledger. Agents bid a deposit, min 60 POA, into a lagoon-like escrow; top 100 win. Winning deposits return glacier-slow after 20 epochs; losers refunded. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots: 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA locked 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, gets it back; scarcity keeps sybils from diluting rewards. Slots are non-transferable, so bought accounts buy none.
